# Pixelate Nest

> Pixelate Nest (Kalahanu Tech Studios LLP) is a creative digital agency based in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India offering web development, mobile app development, software development, video editing, and digital marketing services.

## Company Information

- **Legal Name**: Kalahanu Tech Studios LLP
- **Brand Name**: Pixelate Nest
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Location**: Kala Bhawan, Akharaghat Road, Muzaffarpur, Bihar 842001, India
- **Phone**: +91-84069-12345
- **Email**: support@pixelatenest.com
- **Website**: https://www.pixelatenest.com

## Services

### Web Development
Custom website design, responsive web development, e-commerce platforms, CMS development, WordPress, Shopify, and progressive web apps.
URL: https://www.pixelatenest.com/webdev

### Mobile App Development
iOS and Android app development using Flutter, React Native, Swift, and Kotlin. Cross-platform and native solutions.
URL: https://www.pixelatenest.com/app-dev

### Software Development
Enterprise software, SaaS platforms, CRM systems, ERP solutions, factory management, school management, billing systems, and cloud applications.
URL: https://www.pixelatenest.com/software-dev

### Video Editing & Content Creation
Professional video editing, motion graphics, color grading, sound design, YouTube content, social media videos, and corporate video production.
URL: https://www.pixelatenest.com/video-ed

### Digital Marketing
SEO optimization, social media marketing, content marketing, paid advertising, and brand strategy.

## Products

- **Counter Billing Software**: POS and billing solution for retail businesses
- **Factory Management Software**: Production planning, inventory, quality control for manufacturing
- **School CRM/Management System**: Student enrollment, attendance, fees, and academic management
- **Hotel Management Software**: Room booking, guest management, billing
- **Lead Generation Software**: CRM and sales pipeline management
- **Library Management Software**: Book catalog, lending, and member management
- **Transport Management Software**: Fleet and logistics tracking
- **GST Billing Software**: Indian tax-compliant invoicing

Products URL: https://www.pixelatenest.com/product

## Industries Served

E-commerce, Education, Healthcare, Real Estate, Travel & Hospitality, Logistics, Manufacturing, Utilities & Energy

## Technology Stack

**Frontend**: React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, TypeScript
**Backend**: Node.js, Python Django, FastAPI, PHP Laravel, Express.js
**Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin
**Cloud**: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes
**Databases**: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase
**Video**: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro
**Design**: Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator
